about.title: About PayMatch
about.description: PayMatch is an intelligent payment reconciliation platform designed to automate the matching of incoming payments with merchant transactions. The platform reduces manual reconciliation work, minimizes errors, and accelerates the settlement process for businesses of all sizes.
about.ourMissionDescription: To eliminate manual payment reconciliation work by providing an automated, intelligent matching system that accurately matches incoming payments with transactions, reducing errors and processing time while maintaining the highest security standards.
about.whoWeServeDescription: PayMatch serves merchants who need to reconcile payments, administrators who manage the platform and user accounts, and customers who make payments. Each user role has specific permissions and access tailored to their responsibilities.
about.paymentMatchingDescription: PayMatch automatically matches incoming payments with merchant transactions using intelligent algorithms that compare transaction references, amounts, dates, and customer information to ensure accurate reconciliation.
about.industryStandardsDescription: Compliant with PCI DSS, GDPR, and other international standards to ensure the highest level of security and data protection.
about.platformOverviewDescription: PayMatch provides a comprehensive payment reconciliation solution, including:
about.platformItem1: Automated payment matching using intelligent algorithms
about.platformItem2: Real-time transaction monitoring and reconciliation status
about.platformItem4: Multi-role user management with role-based access control
about.platformItem5: Advanced security features and data encryption
about.platformItem6: Comprehensive API for integration with payment gateways and accounting systems
about.platformItem7: Dashboard analytics showing matching rates and reconciliation metrics
about.platformItem8: Exception handling for unmatched payments and discrepancies

features.title: Key Features
features.description: PayMatch offers intelligent payment reconciliation features designed to automate payment matching, reduce manual work, and provide accurate financial reporting for merchants.
features.automatedPaymentMatchingDescription: Intelligent algorithms automatically match incoming payments with transactions using references, amounts, and dates.
features.advancedSecurityDescription: End-to-end encryption, secure data storage, and role-based access control for all payment data.
features.realtimeReconciliationDescription: Instant payment matching and reconciliation status updates as payments are received.
features.reconciliationAnalyticsDescription: Comprehensive dashboards showing matching rates, unmatched payments, and reconciliation metrics.
features.roleBasedAccessDescription: Granular permissions for merchants, administrators, and customers with role-specific dashboards.
features.multiplePaymentSourcesDescription: Support for matching payments from various sources including bank transfers, payment gateways, and digital wallets.
features.dataProtectionDescription: Compliant with GDPR, PCI DSS, and other data protection regulations for secure payment handling.
features.settlementReconciliationDescription: Automated reconciliation of settlements with matched transactions and exception handling.
features.matchingNotificationsDescription: Real-time notifications for successful matches, unmatched payments, and reconciliation status updates.

clients.title: Clients

It serves as the foundation for your billing operations, allowing you to store comprehensive client details that can be automatically populated when creating quotes, invoices, and other business documents.
clients.overviewDescription2: Every client record includes contact information, billing addresses, tax identification numbers, payment terms, and custom fields. This centralized approach eliminates data duplication and ensures consistency across all your business transactions.

payments.overviewDescription2: When a payment is recorded, the system intelligently matches it to the corresponding invoice based on amount, client, and reference numbers. This automated matching reduces manual data entry, eliminates errors, and provides real-time visibility into your cash flow.

creditNotes.overviewDescription1: Credit Notes are official documents used to reduce the amount a client owes or to provide refunds for products or services. They serve as the opposite of invoices, crediting the client's account and adjusting financial records accordingly.
creditNotes.overviewDescription2: Common uses include processing refunds, correcting invoice errors, applying discounts after invoicing, handling returns, and adjusting account balances. recurringInvoices.description: Automate recurring billing for subscriptions, retainer services, and repeat transactions. Set billing cycles and let invoices generate automatically on schedule.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Find answers to common questions about PayMatch, its features, and how to use the platform effectively.
faqs.question1: How does PayMatch automatically match payments with transactions?
faqs.answer1: PayMatch uses intelligent matching algorithms that compare incoming payments with merchant transactions based on transaction references, payment amounts, dates, customer information, and other matching criteria. The system automatically identifies matches and flags exceptions for manual review.
faqs.question2: What happens when a payment cannot be matched?
faqs.answer2: When a payment cannot be automatically matched, it is flagged as an exception and appears in the unmatched payments section. Merchants can review these payments, see why they couldn't be matched, and manually match them with the correct transaction or resolve discrepancies.
faqs.question3: How often does PayMatch run reconciliation?
faqs.answer3: Reconciliation schedules can be configured per merchant. Common options include daily, weekly, or monthly reconciliation runs. The system can also perform real-time matching as payments are received, depending on your configuration.
faqs.question4: How do I get started as a merchant?
faqs.answer4: To get started, register for a merchant account through the PayMatch registration process. Complete your business information, verify your email, and submit required verification documents. Once your account is approved by an administrator, you can configure matching rules, connect payment sources, and start reconciling payments.
faqs.question5: What payment sources can PayMatch reconcile?
faqs.answer5: PayMatch can reconcile payments from various sources including bank transfers, payment gateways, digital wallets, and other payment processors. The system integrates with multiple payment providers to automatically receive payment data for matching.
faqs.question6: Can I integrate PayMatch with my accounting system?
faqs.answer6: Yes, PayMatch provides a comprehensive RESTful API that allows you to integrate reconciliation data with your existing accounting systems, ERP software, and financial reporting tools. We offer detailed API documentation and developer support.
faqs.answer7: PayMatch provides various reconciliation reports including matching status reports, unmatched payment reports, reconciliation summaries, and settlement reports. All reports can be exported in CSV, PDF, or Excel formats for accounting and audit purposes.
faqs.question8: How accurate is the automatic payment matching?
faqs.answer8: PayMatch's matching algorithms are highly accurate, typically achieving matching rates of 90% or higher depending on data quality. The system uses multiple matching criteria and can be configured with custom matching rules to improve accuracy for specific business needs.
faqs.question9: What kind of support is available?
faqs.answer9: PayMatch offers comprehensive support including documentation, API guides, email support, and for enterprise customers, dedicated account managers. We also provide training on reconciliation workflows and best practices.
faqs.question10: Is PayMatch compliant with data protection regulations?
faqs.answer10: Yes, PayMatch is compliant with major data protection regulations including GDPR (for EU users), PCI DSS (for payment data), and other regional requirements. We implement strict data protection measures, encryption, and privacy controls to secure all payment and transaction data.
